page.overview:
Who is Alman I?

Emperor Alman I (d. 123 AG) was the seventh Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 104–123 AG), succeeding his brother-in-law Elrood I al-Aziz as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Alman founded the House of Alman Corrino, which for centuries would struggle with the senior House of Saluso Corrino for rule over the Imperium.

Before his rise as emperor, Alman was known as Alman bin Haig. He was thus presumably the son of a man named Haig. Alman was a brother-in-law of Emperor Elrood I al-Aziz (r. 104–123) and thus married to a daughter of Emperor Saudir I (r. 12 BG–70 AG).

In 123, Elrood I was assassinated and Alman replaced him on the throne, founding the House of Alman Corrino. Elrood's nephew and rightful heir, Saudir II Negara II, fled into exile. In 122, Alman brought a bill of attainder before the Landsraad, accusing Elias Atreides of supporting the forces of the exiled prince. Alman was himself assassinated in 123 AG, before the bill could be acted upon. Saudir II then assumed the throne. Among Saudir II's actions as emperor was to reconfirm Elias Atreides in his titles.
